Subject: Clearwave renewal launch — propose QBR slots & capacity options

Hi Alex / Marta —

Hope you’re both well. Your current term is up for renewal in late October (renewal date 2026-10-28). I’m kicking off the renewal + expansion conversation so we can: align on any term changes, review usage and headroom, and lock a QBR slot for an executive review.

Quick proposed timeline:
- Week of Sep 13: internal prep + confirm budget/PO owner
- Week of Sep 20: QBR with execs (30–45m) + technical capacity review (60m)
- First half of Oct: finalize SOW and any term amendments

Proposed QBR slots (Pacific):
- Tues, Sep 21: 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed, Sep 22: 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Thu, Sep 23: 11:00–11:45am PT

What I need from you:
1) Which QBR slot works best (or propose another)
2) Confirm the internal attendees (exec sponsor + technical lead + procurement contact) — I see Marta copied but if there is a procurement / finance owner please introduce them
3) Any growth targets for next 12 months (rough token uplift or feature priorities) so we can prepare capacity and pricing scenarios

Attached: usage snapshot (Clearwave_usage_report_Q3_2026.csv) and a draft SOW to start the conversation (SOW_draft_v1.pdf).

If helpful we can also include a brief capacity uplift options sheet in the QBR (quantized tiering, burst pool, or dedicated reserved capacity).

Thanks — I’ll hold the three slots and will update once I hear back.

Best,
Irene Choi
